definition: Agency-reported SF133 actual budget authority and execution, September/fourth-quarter AMT4. Not presidential requests. limitations: Last full Biden fiscal year FY2024 versus latest completed Trump fiscal year FY2026; not January 19 point-in-time budgets.
Non-financing accounts are the default; financing accounts are retained separately.
Missing source years and absent line metrics remain unknown, not zero.
Account topics crosswalk exact OMB codes; unmatched accounts remain explicitly unclassified.
Cross-cutting climate-specific amounts require finer program allocations; an environment/energy account total is not all climate spending.

classification_source.definition: An account receives a single purpose only when the official account crosswalk yields one primary function. Mixed-account actual funding is not allocated using estimated shares.

availability_audit.definition: No source observation is never converted to zero. A zero authority metric is reconstructed only from an explicit SF133 resource/balance identity, with source rows retained. Cancellation and successor status require separate evidence.
